fields.name: layer_count
fields.rationale: The product is described as having one to five layers, which is a key characteristic of the panel's structure and affects its mechanical properties.
evidence: The results refer to a representative average of one- to five-layered nordpan solid wood panels.

fields.name: adhesive_system
fields.rationale: The adhesive system is mentioned as part of the production process, which is crucial for the structural integrity and performance of the wood panels.
evidence: Lumber production includes direct emissions from drying processes based on a worst-case approximation. Upstream emissions from the use of binding agents rely on supplier-specific data complemented by secondary data.
inference_basis: Adhesive systems are typically used in multi-layered wood products to bond layers together.
